name: King of Hearts

gender_note.quote: The judge, by the way, was the King; and as he wore his crown over the wig

base_age_note.reason: Not stated; an elderly, mild, anxious monarch beside a younger, fiercer Queen.

hair.style: thinning grey hair and a short, neatly trimmed grey beard; at the trial covered by a full judge's wig
hair.quote: “That’s the judge,” she said to herself, “because of his great wig.”
hair.reason: Wig sourced; natural hair and beard designed.

eyes.shape: small and deep-set under heavy lids — when he frowns they nearly disappear
eyes.quote: frowning at the cook till his eyes were nearly out of sight
eyes.reason: Deep-set frowning eyes sourced; colour designed.

skin.tone: pale, slightly sallow, goes paler when frightened
skin.quote: The King turned pale, and shut his note-book hastily

face.default_expression: anxious, melancholy, eager to please; a pleased little smile after a feeble pun
face.quote: the King put on his spectacles and looked anxiously round / with a melancholy air / looking round the court with a smile

build.scale_reference: about 1.2x Alice's true size (135 cm); clearly a head shorter than the Queen
build.reason: Not stated; designed so the henpecked King is visibly dwarfed by his Queen.

marks.description: gold crown perched awkwardly on top of a full judge's wig — uncomfortable and unbecoming
in the procession he walks bareheaded: the Knave carries his crown before him on a crimson velvet cushion
spectacles and a small note-book he writes in (Rule Forty-two)

default_outfit_tone.summary: crimson and white card-suited court dress matching the Queen: flat rectangular crimson tabard piped in white with a red heart device and a small crown device, over a crimson robe trimmed with white fur; at the trial a judge's long wig under the crown
default_outfit_tone.silhouette_1862: long ceremonial robe over 1862 frock coat and trousers, rigid flat card-front tabard; stands square-on like a court card
default_outfit_tone.reason: Hearts suit and wig sourced (ch008-p11, ch011-p03); card styling per SUP-004 and FAC-house-of-hearts emblem_visual. Costume detail by 06-art/costume.

touches: flat rigid card-front tabard with heart pip and crown device
performer_coding.limits: human performer, no painted-card body suit, no CGI flattening (SUP-002/SUP-004)

prompt_base_en: a short, round-shouldered, mild English king of about sixty in 1862, thinning grey hair and a neat short grey beard, small deep-set pale blue eyes, pale round jowly face with an anxious expression, reading spectacles, flat crimson-and-white card-front tabard with a red heart over a crimson robe trimmed with white fur
